ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity pixel distribution (>95% dark pixels) with high-intensity pixels limited to specular glare at the trailing edges and fluke-water interface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Approximately 70-degree V-shaped notch; central vertex depth corresponds to roughly 15% of total lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular jagged boundary; left lobe features deep, high-amplitude serrations (macro-notches), while the right lobe displays a higher frequency of lower-amplitude micro-serrations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex leading edge curves; trailing edges exhibit a concave sweep towards the median notch with asymmetrical deviations.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent irregular V-shaped excision or trauma mark on the trailing edge of the left lobe, approximately mid-way between the tip and the median notch.
other_distinctive_markers: Severe silhouette effect due to backlighting, resulting in high edge-contrast but complete loss of internal surface pigmentation data.
